`$inspect` logs its values every time they change. It is for debugging and is usually not meant to stay in the code. The rule looks at components in runes mode under Svelte 5.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-inspect": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<script>
  let count = $state(0);
  $inspect(count);
</script>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<script>
  let count = $state(0);
</script>
```
